name: Tribhovandas Bhimji Zaveri Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2007, Tribhovandas Bhimji Zaveri Ltd is in the business of retail sales of ornaments made of gold, diamond, silver, platinum and precious stones[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
TBZ, a 150-year-old family-run Indian jewellery business, was the first to introduce 100% BIS hallmarked 22 karat gold jewellery, certified solitaire diamonds, and a lifetime buyback scheme on gold and diamond jewellery. It pioneered lightweight precious jewellery and offers handcrafted gold, diamond, jadau, and platinum jewellery for various occasions, as well as contemporary designs for daily wear.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 24.7% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 24.2%
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 7.68% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 9.28% over last 3 years.
